Welcome to BottleCaller

BottleCaller trains servers to sell the right wine by matching guest psychology with the right tone and prompt style — in under 5 minutes.

  • Diagnose the guest
  • Flash Wine Learn the Wine

How to play: Press Start, read the table scene, then choose one response card at a time to move the guest toward the right bottle.
